logic_errors: Draft restoration captured all displayed values rather than only user changes and could overlay stale server state.
Draft restoration could strip ordered/booked presentation from work controls.
Draft restoration omitted editable non-authoritative client/location values.
DOM replacement plus focus() did not preserve caret selection.
resolution: Rejected overlay restoration was removed. The revised implementation treats an open details form as a background-refresh draft boundary and adds displayed-value baselines for authoritative save fields.
